autoAccept.description: AutoAccept enables automatic lease creation when bids are selected

deploymentRef.description: DeploymentRef references a specific deployment (overrides selector)

namespace.description: Namespace of the Deployment resource (optional, defaults to same namespace)

excludedProviders.description: ExcludedProviders is a list of provider addresses to exclude

maxBids.description: MaxBids is the maximum number of bids to wait for before selection

maxPrice.description: MaxPrice is the maximum acceptable price per block in uAKT

minProviderScore.description: MinProviderScore is the minimum provider reputation score (0-100)

preferredProviders.description: PreferredProviders is a list of preferred provider addresses (higher priority)

requiredAttributes.description: RequiredAttributes is a list of required provider attributes

items.description: ProviderAttribute defines a required provider attribute

value.description: Value is the required attribute value

selectionStrategy.description: SelectionStrategy defines how to select from qualifying bids

selector.description: Selector defines label selector to match Deployment CRs

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description:
A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that
relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description:
operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values.
Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description:
values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn,
the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist,
the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic
merge patch.

matchLabels.description:
matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels
map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the
operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

waitTime.description:
WaitTime is deprecated. Bid collection timing is now managed automatically
using Kubernetes controller-runtime mechanisms based on deployment creation time.

status.description: A DeploymentStatus represents the observed state of a Deployment.

atProvider.description: DeploymentObservation are the observable fields of a Deployment.

bids.description:
Bids is the total count of bids the chain has ever recorded for this
deployment, regardless of state. Stays >0 after the bid window
expires so users can see "providers did bid, just couldn't win"
— see #29.

bidsOpen.description:
BidsOpen is the count of bids in the Open state (i.e., still
awaiting acceptance). Drops to 0 once the bid window passes even
though Bids stays at its high-water mark.

createdHeight.description: CreatedHeight is the block height when deployment was created

deploymentId.description: DeploymentId is the deployment sequence number assigned by Akash

escrowBalance.description: EscrowBalance is the current escrow account balance

leasesActive.description:
LeasesActive is the count of currently-active leases on chain for this
deployment, contributing to the Phase derivation.

ordersOpen.description:
OrdersOpen is the count of currently-open orders on chain for this
deployment, contributing to the Phase derivation.

owner.description: Owner is the deployment owner address from ProviderConfig

phase.description:
Phase is a derived high-level lifecycle phase for the Deployment that
folds in market state (orders, leases) so users can see why bids may
not be appearing without reading multiple resources. Possible values:
  - "Pending"   : not yet broadcast to chain
  - "Bidding"   : on chain, an order is open and providers may bid
  - "Leased"    : at least one lease is active
  - "Expired"   : on chain, no leases active and no orders open
                  (typical "console-expired" deployment past bid window)
  - "Closed"    : chain marked the deployment closed (escrow drained
                  or owner closed it)

state.description:
State is the raw deployment state reported by Akash chain ("active",
"closed").
